Name: Cleaner Beach and Tide Pools walkable
Author: BoogieBest
Description:
[center]works with the new SDV 1.5

What does it do: (see pictures)

- Removes some debris
- You can now walk across the tide pools
- two versions: FULL and only walkable tide pool (if you have other mods which change the beach this version might be best)
- also changes the beach map for diffrent events accordingly
- fully configurable: choose which version do you want, all ingame with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


INSTALLATION:
1. make sure to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but recommended.
2. download the  zip
3. unzip/extract it
4. place the folder into your Mods folder.
5. Configuration.json gets created after first start with the mod. You can
edit the settings via Generic Mod Config Menu if you have it installed.
6. feedback is welcome, enjoy :)!



DEINSTALLATION:
delete the folder inside your mods.

COMPATIBILITY:
Works with everything that does not edit/replace the beach.tbin Map.


Thanks for your download, enjoy and let me know if you have any suggestions or find bugs!
